test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no.5.
solution:
The correct answer is 'weakened'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The sentence with the blank talks about a certain role played by forests in the planet
 
• In the passage it has been mentioned how forests modulate the gases in the atmosphere by taking in carbon dioxide and giving out oxygen. 
 
• This same modulation is performed by **lungs** in the human body which take in oxygen and gives out carbon dioxide. 
 
• Thus, option 2 is the correct answer.

*Correct passage - **When trees are illegally or irresponsibly cut, forest ecosystems are (1) weakened. Their ability to store carbon, shelter wildlife, filter water, and to provide food, products, and jobs for (2) people is compromised. Global forest loss also leads to more greenhouse gases in the (3) atmosphere. This is much more than what comes from all cars, trucks, trains, planes and ships in the world. But when forests thrive, they absorb carbon dioxide and (4) slow down climate change. Protecting forests does much more than just keep trees standing because forests are the (5) lungs of the planet and serve as the home, market and apothecary of people living on it.*
